title: This Trump ‘participation trophy’ perfectly mocks his second term

paragraphs.text: Since President Donald Trump began the Iran war nearly five months ago, he has repeatedly said it’s almost over or that the U.S. has, in fact, already won. His resumption of the conflict is just the latest sign that neither of those claims are true.
paragraphs.translation: 自總統唐納·川普在近五個月前發動伊朗戰爭以來，他多次表示戰爭已接近尾聲，或美國實際上已經獲勝。他重啟衝突正是證明這兩項說法皆非事實的最新跡象。

paragraphs.text: While Trump’s antagonistic second-term foreign policy is unlikely to win him any actual peace prizes, the President didn’t need to earn the new participation trophy on the National Mall. The oversized, satirical statue awards him a prize for just showing up.
paragraphs.translation: 雖然川普充滿敵意的第二任期外交政策不太可能為他贏得任何實際的和平獎，但這位總統並不需要靠實力來獲得國家廣場上這座新的參與獎獎盃。這座巨大的諷刺雕像頒發給他一個獎項，僅僅是為了表彰他的出席。

paragraphs.text: Iran War Participation Trophy is a 10-foot-tall trophy made of wood, foam, and plaster by the anonymous protest art group The Secret Handshake. The group’s previous installations on the National Mall include a statue of Trump and Jeffrey Epstein frolicking hand-in-hand, and another that depicts the pair as if in the movie Titanic. The group has also created an arcade game about the Iran war that’s impossible to win. The trophy is up near the Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial on the Tidal Basin.
paragraphs.translation: 「伊朗戰爭參與獎獎盃」是一座高 10 英尺的獎盃，由匿名抗議藝術團體「秘密握手」（The Secret Handshake）以木材、泡沫塑料和石膏製成。該團體先前在國家廣場上的裝置作品包括川普與傑佛瑞·艾普斯坦手拉手嬉戲的雕像，以及另一座將兩人描繪成電影《鐵達尼號》場景的雕像。該團體還開發了一款關於伊朗戰爭且無法獲勝的街機遊戲。該獎盃目前設置在潮汐湖畔的馬丁·路德·金紀念碑附近。

paragraphs.text: The piece is a loving cup-style trophy with two tall decorative handles, “#1” written on the cup’s front, and “Participant” written on the base. A plaque affixed to the display says the award is made out to Trump “for his enthusiastic involvement in the Iran war. While some concern themselves with military strategy, diplomacy, or measurable outcomes, President Trump demonstrated the courage to participate regardless of the final score.”
paragraphs.translation: 該作品是一座愛心杯風格的獎盃，有兩個高大的裝飾手把，杯前寫著「#1」，底座寫著「參與者」。展示架上貼著的一塊牌匾寫著，這個獎項頒給川普是「為了表彰他在伊朗戰爭中的熱情參與。當某些人關注軍事策略、外交或可衡量的結果時，川普總統展現了不計最終得分而參與的勇氣」。

paragraphs.text: Another plaque that’s part of the display invites visitors to bring their own trophies. Plastic trophies are already set along its base.
paragraphs.translation: 展示裝置的另一塊牌匾邀請遊客攜帶自己的獎盃。底座旁已經擺放了一些塑料獎盃。

paragraphs.text: “We didn’t make up the idea of a big dumb trophy as being important. He did,” The Secret Handshake tells Fast Company in an email. “And he even admitted when he didn’t win the Nobel Prize that he doesn’t feel the need to think about peace anymore. And now we’re out there literally destroying a nation. Lives are being lost. Iranians and Americans. Over seemingly the pursuit of recognition and shiny gold things.”
paragraphs.translation: 「秘密握手」在電子郵件中告訴《Fast Company》：「並不是我們虛構了大笨獎盃很重要的想法，是他（川普）開的頭。他甚至在沒拿到諾貝爾獎時承認，他覺得不再需要考慮和平了。而現在我們在那裡字面上摧毀一個國家。生命正在流逝。包括伊朗人和美國人。這一切似乎只是為了追求認可和閃亮亮的黃金物品。」

paragraphs.text: The group says the purpose of the work is to visualize the stupidity of the war’s justification—and to do so in a larger-than-life way. Its work parodies Trump’s second term by mimicking Trump’s own ostentatious style and affinity for gold, as seen in the president’s various side projects under development in Washington, D.C.
paragraphs.translation: 該團體表示，這部作品的目的是將這場戰爭辯解的愚蠢之處具象化——並以一種誇張的方式呈現。它的作品模仿了川普那種浮誇的風格和對黃金的喜愛，正如在華盛頓特區開發中的各項總統副業項目中所見的那樣，以此來戲仿川普的第二任期。

quiz.sentence: Each student in the summer camp will receive a certificate of ____ for completing the program.
quiz.sentence_zh: 參加夏令營的每位學生都將獲得一張完成該計畫的參與證書。

quiz.sentence: The police received a tip from an ____ caller about the location of the stolen goods.
quiz.sentence_zh: 警方接到一名匿名撥打者的舉報，告知了被盜物品的地點。

quiz.sentence: The artist tried to ____ the beauty of the countryside in her latest oil painting.
quiz.sentence_zh: 這位藝術家試圖在她最新的油畫中描繪鄉村之美。

quiz.sentence: He decided to go ahead with the plan ____ of the risks involved.
quiz.sentence_zh: 他不顧涉及的風險，決定繼續執行該計畫。

quiz.sentence: The final ____ of the negotiation was better than anyone had expected.
quiz.sentence_zh: 談判的最終結果比任何人預期的都要好。

quiz.sentence: It is rude to ____ the way someone speaks just because they have an accent.
quiz.sentence_zh: 僅僅因為某人有口音就嘲笑他說話的方式是很無禮的。

quiz.sentence: I didn't think he would actually ____ to the party after we had that argument.
quiz.sentence_zh: 在我們那次爭吵之後，我不認為他真的會出現在派對上。

quiz.sentence: Don't believe everything he says; he likes to ____ stories to get attention.
quiz.sentence_zh: 不要相信他所說的一切；他喜歡編造故事來吸引注意。

quiz.sentence: The company provided a detailed ____ for the increase in service fees.
quiz.sentence_zh: 該公司為服務費的調漲提供了詳細的辯解理由。

quiz.sentence: Parrots are famous for their ability to ____ human speech sounds.
quiz.sentence_zh: 鸚鵡以模仿人類語言聲音的能力而聞名。
